description: GMX total value locked on Arbitrum in USD from DefiLlama's public API: current value and daily history for the last 1 to 30 days. This is TVL as DefiLlama reports it, not GMX's own trading volume or fees. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
